newsitem.title: USA: American Tech gets interest in device.
newsitem.headline: American Tech gets interest in device.

text.p: American Technologies Group Inc said on Thursday that it has received two non-binding letters of intent for development, manufacture and marketing in India of its low temperature vacuum distiller technology.
Each letter of intent includes provisions for a licensing fee and royalty payable to American Technologies, the company said.
The letters of intents cover development of a WaterDew distiller processing between 8 and 12 gallons of water per day to produce safe drinking water.
American Technologies said it is negotiating with other manufacturers for similar arrangements in other areas of the world.
Also, American Technologies said it has signed a non-binding tentative deal for an Indian publishing firm to publish Final Frontier Magazine, a publication devoted to space and science, in India.
Further details were not immediately available.
